text: The issue is resolved. The fix in `inifile/parser.py` replaces `line.split("=")` (which broke on every `=`) with `line.partition("=")` (splitting only on the first `=`), and removes the `value.split("#")[0]` truncation that was cutting values at `#`. Both example values now come back exactly as written, and all tests pass.
